final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(byte_rate - avg_rate) AS avg_excess_rate FROM media_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE byte_rate > avg_rate
